events.title: Guided Spanish Nature Walk from Kumeyaay Lake Campground
events.description:
Join MTRP Trail Guides on a guided nature walk in Spanish and learn about the plants, animals, geology, history, and ecology of the park.  This walk will explore scenic Kumeyaay Lake.

This walk will start from the Kumeyaay Lake Campground Entry Station at 8:30 a.m.  and is free and open to the public, with no reservations required.
The trails used are easy, but have uneven surfaces and some involve steps, so be sure to wear sturdy, closed-toe shoes and bring along water.  A hat and sunscreen are also recommended.  Walks are canceled if raining.

events.title: Special Guided Nature Walk from Kumeyaay Lake Campground for City Nature Challenge
events.description:
Join MTRP Trail Guides on a special guided nature walk from the Kumeyaay Lake Campground day use parking lot to use iNaturalist to record plants, insects, and other living things in nature as part of the international City Nature Challenge.  Learn more about CNC at https://www.sdnhm.org/education/community-science/city-nature-challenge/city-nature-challenge-events .
iNaturalist is an easy-to-use database that records photos of wild living things that can be used as scientific data to study biodiversity and other issues.  To get started, go to: inaturalist.org/pages/getting. started.  Then download the free app to your mobile device and create your account.  Come at 8:00 AM for assistance with the app.
We’ll explore the east side of Mission Trails and find species to photograph and upload to iNaturalist.  Help us understand the biodiversity of Mission Trails and San Diego County.
This walk is free, and no registration is required.  The trails used are easy, but have uneven surfaces and may involve steps, so be sure to wear sturdy, closed-toe shoes and bring along water.  A hat and sunscreen are also recommended.  Walk will be canceled if raining.

events.description:
Join MTRP Park Ranger Brandon Botticelli for a campfire program at the scenic Lake Amphitheater in Kumeyaay Lake Campground.  Join in singing some familiar songs as the campfire flames begin to flicker and cast a glow over the area.  Trail Guide Robin Johnson-Drogo will then present a program on predatory-prey relationships.  Learn the fascinating interactions between roadrunners and rattlesnakes, the antlion and ant, and more.  Nature always inspires!

This program is free with no reservations required.  Please park in the dirt lot at the corner of Father Junipero Serra Trail and Bushy Hill Dr. across from the campground.  Walk into the campground and follow the road past the entry station around to the short Lake Amphitheater trail at campsite #10.  Mosquitoes are likely so take precautions.

events.title: Campfire Program - Kumeyaay History
events.description:
Join MTRP Park Ranger Brandon Botticelli for a campfire program at the scenic Lake Amphitheater in Kumeyaay Lake Campground.  Join in singing some familiar songs as the campfire flames flicker and cast a glow over the area.  A representative from the Barona Museum will then present a program on the Kumeyaay, the indigenous people from this area.  For thousands of years, the Kumeyaay lived sustainability using natural resources found in Mission Trails.  Come and hear their story!

This program is free with no reservations required.  Please park in the dirt lot at the corner of Father Junipero Serra Trail and Bushy Hill Dr. across from the campground.
